notes.text: איש גליא means “man of Galya,” rendered “of Galya.” Galya retains the final aleph of גליא; its vowels and geographical identification remain uncertain.
Ketubot 60a follows ס. under the period convention. Hyman says “mentioned in a baraita”; no named edition is independently checked.
